name: Cooktown Museum
scope: Standing former St Mary’s Convent and School, now Cooktown Museum. Covers the historic L-shaped gothic brick ranges, west two-storey veranda, roof dormers and rear gallery and kitchen volume.

originalReview.notes: Matching scan of the historic photograph carried by Qualla. The State Library of Queensland identifies its original negative 70851 and labels the photograph out of copyright. Normalized against the published Qualla JPEG at 512x386, the grayscale pixel correlation is 0.999963. Native archive rendition binds the file and rights; used only retained facade, gable and iron roof traits.

review.notes: Checked the historic Qualla photograph first. Used the matched State Library scan and exact catalogue item, and excluded contemporary CC-BY-SA imagery.
